name: core-ask-once-for-ambiguous-hooks
query:
Set up Kraft Lite in this repo (thumbnail-service, a small Python image API). There is no .kraft-lite directory yet and I want to run the default chain. I'm about to leave my desk, so ask me anything you need in one go.

`python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/kl.py" detect` run from the repo root prints:
{
  "test_command": [
    "pytest",
    "-q"
  ],
  "ci_command": [
    "gh",
    "pr",
    "checks"
  ],
  "skills": {
    "on.mr.rebase": [],
    "on.spec.requested": [
      "superpowers:brainstorming"
    ],
    "on.plan.requested": [
      "superpowers:writing-plans"
    ],
    "on.chain.review_ready": [],
    "on.env.prepare": [
      "superpowers:using-git-worktrees"
    ],
    "on.implementation.start": [
      "superpowers:test-driven-development"
    ],
    "on.repos.scan": [],
    "on.test.run": [],
    "on.review.local.run": [
      "superpowers:requesting-code-review",
      "pr-review-toolkit:review-pr"
    ],
    "on.mr.describe": [],
    "on.mr.open": [
      "superpowers:finishing-a-development-branch"
    ],
    "on.ci.poll": [],
    "on.review.mr.run": [
      "superpowers:requesting-code-review",
      "pr-review-toolkit:review-pr"
    ],
    "on.human_review.requested": [],
    "on.mr.sync": [],
    "on.merge": [
      "superpowers:finishing-a-development-branch"
    ],
    "on.merge.watch": []
  }
}
expected_behavior: Runs kl.py detect from the repo root before writing anything
Asks the person one question that lists both ambiguous hooks together (on.review.local.run and on.review.mr.run, each with requesting-code-review and review-pr), not one question per hook
Does not ask about hooks with exactly one candidate, such as on.spec.requested or on.merge
Binds on.test.run as kind: subprocess with command [pytest, -q] and on.ci.poll as kind: subprocess with command [gh, pr, checks], taken verbatim from detect
Every kind: skill entry it writes has a prompt sibling, and hooks with no candidate (such as on.mr.describe) get kind: prompt with a one-line instruction

name: trap-no-command-detect-did-not-report
query:
Run Kraft Lite init in the invoice-cli repo. It's a Python CLI; we run tests with tox and CI is CircleCI (there is a tox.ini and a .circleci/config.yml at the root). No registry exists yet.

`python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/kl.py" detect` prints:
{
  "test_command": null,
  "ci_command": null,
  "skills": {
    "on.mr.rebase": [],
    "on.spec.requested": [
      "superpowers:brainstorming"
    ],
    "on.plan.requested": [],
    "on.chain.review_ready": [],
    "on.env.prepare": [],
    "on.implementation.start": [],
    "on.repos.scan": [],
    "on.test.run": [],
    "on.review.local.run": [],
    "on.mr.describe": [],
    "on.mr.open": [],
    "on.ci.poll": [],
    "on.review.mr.run": [],
    "on.human_review.requested": [],
    "on.mr.sync": [],
    "on.merge": [],
    "on.merge.watch": []
  }
}
expected_behavior: Writes .kraft-lite/registry.yaml with on.test.run as kind: prompt, not kind: subprocess
Writes on.ci.poll as kind: prompt with an instruction to report the pipeline's state once
Does not write any command detect did not report (no tox, pytest -q, npm or circleci command) as a subprocess binding
Binds on.spec.requested to superpowers:brainstorming without asking, since it is the only candidate, and gives it a prompt sibling
Gives every one of the 17 hooks detect listed a column-zero key with an indented body

name: boundary-existing-registry-is-not-overwritten
query:
Kraft Lite said the hook on.merge.watch has no registry binding when I tried to start a chain in the ledger-sync repo. Fix the registry for me. I've hand-edited it, so be careful with it.

`.kraft-lite/registry.yaml` currently contains:

# our registry, hand-edited
on.mr.rebase:
  kind: prompt
  prompt: Rebase onto origin/main, resolve conflicts, never force-push.
on.spec.requested:
  kind: skill
  skill: superpowers:brainstorming
  prompt: Agree requirements and write a spec before any code.
on.plan.requested:
  kind: skill
  skill: superpowers:writing-plans
  prompt: Write a task-by-task plan from the spec.
on.chain.review_ready:
  kind: prompt
  prompt: Show the spec and plan together and ask whether the chain is final.
on.env.prepare:
  kind: prompt
  prompt: Run `make bootstrap` and confirm it exits 0.
on.implementation.start:
  kind: skill
  skill: superpowers:test-driven-development
  prompt: Implement the plan test-first.
on.repos.scan:
  kind: prompt
  prompt: List files changed outside src/ and tests/.
on.test.run:
  kind: subprocess
  command: [make, check]
on.review.local.run:
  kind: skill
  skill: pr-review-toolkit:review-pr
  prompt: Review the diff before it goes up.
on.mr.describe:
  kind: prompt
  prompt: Write the MR description from the branch.
on.mr.open:
  kind: prompt
  prompt: Open the merge request with glab mr create.
on.ci.poll:
  kind: prompt
  prompt: Report the pipeline's state once.
on.review.mr.run:
  kind: prompt
  prompt: Review the merge request as a reviewer would.
on.human_review.requested:
  kind: prompt
  prompt: Ask the human to review the merge request.
on.mr.sync:
  kind: prompt
  prompt: Rewrite the MR description from the final branch.
on.merge:
  kind: prompt
  prompt: Merge with glab mr merge once approved.

`python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/kl.py" detect` prints:
{
  "test_command": [
    "make",
    "test"
  ],
  "ci_command": [
    "glab",
    "ci",
    "status"
  ],
  "skills": {
    "on.mr.rebase": [],
    "on.spec.requested": [
      "superpowers:brainstorming"
    ],
    "on.plan.requested": [
      "superpowers:writing-plans"
    ],
    "on.chain.review_ready": [],
    "on.env.prepare": [],
    "on.implementation.start": [
      "superpowers:test-driven-development"
    ],
    "on.repos.scan": [],
    "on.test.run": [],
    "on.review.local.run": [
      "pr-review-toolkit:review-pr"
    ],
    "on.mr.describe": [],
    "on.mr.open": [],
    "on.ci.poll": [],
    "on.review.mr.run": [],
    "on.human_review.requested": [],
    "on.mr.sync": [],
    "on.merge": [],
    "on.merge.watch": []
  }
}
expected_behavior: Runs kl.py detect and builds the new registry without writing over .kraft-lite/registry.yaml first
Shows the person a diff against the existing file, including the added on.merge.watch binding
Points out that detect's make test would replace the person's own on.test.run command [make, check]
Asks the person to confirm before writing, and does not overwrite their hand-edited file in this turn
